chinese_policy: Chinese table text preserved verbatim from the supplied document; English translated for this interface.

zh: 电力公司按你发的每一度电付钱，单价按系统大小分档，计划在 2033 年底结束
en: HK$4/kWh at ≤10 kW; HK$3/kWh above 10–200 kW; ends 2033-12-31
The electricity company pays for each unit you generate. The rate depends on system size, and the scheme ends in 2033.

zh: 板连同板与板之间的空隙，不能盖过屋顶面积的一半。把空隙也算进去，是我们偏保守的解读
来源：机电署 FAQ 5.3；“含空隙”为假设
en: Half of the covered building area
Panels and the gaps between them must cover no more than half the roof. Counting the gaps is our conservative interpretation.
Source: EMSD FAQ 5.3; including gaps is an assumption

zh: 等于你输入的“长 × 阔”
真实屋子通常比可以放板的地方大，所以我们算出的上限偏小，结果偏保守
en: The building is usually larger than the clear area for panels. This makes our coverage limit smaller and the result more conservative.

zh: 卫星推算每小时的日照，再按天文台京士柏 2025 年实测总量下调约 3%
en: Hourly sunlight estimates are reduced by about 3% to match the 2025 annual total observed at HKO King’s Park.

zh: 每层 3 m，影响范围为正南左右各 60°
用“几层、多远”算出邻屋挡住多高的天空。香港的太阳主要从南面照过来
en: 3 m per floor; 60° either side of south
We use floors and distance to estimate how much sky is blocked. Sunlight in Hong Kong mainly comes from the south.

zh: 市面常见规格的通用代表，不是某个品牌的型号
en: A generic example of a common panel size, not a named manufacturer’s model.

zh: 逆变器、电线、灰尘、高温等加起来的损失
en: Losses from the inverter, wiring, dust and heat reduce useful electricity.

zh: 面板发电能力每年慢慢下降
en: The panels gradually generate less electricity as they age.

zh: 一块板里的电池是一串串连起来的。阴影哪怕只遮住底部一小条，整串的电流也会下降，所以损失比被遮的面积还大。我们按这个较保守的方法计算
来源：pvlib 文档中的方法
en: Cells are connected in strings. A narrow strip of shade can reduce a whole string’s current, so the electrical loss can exceed the shaded area. We use this more conservative method.

zh: 每块板分成 3 段，每段有“绕道”开关；一段被遮时会被跳过，另外两段照常发电
en: Each panel has three sections with bypass switches. A shaded section can be bypassed while the other two keep generating.

zh: 前排的影子只会落在后排正对着的那一段上
en: A front row’s shadow affects only the part of the row behind it that the shadow actually overlaps.

zh: 前后排之间至少留 0.3 m
留空间让人走进去清洁和维修
en: Space is left between rows for cleaning and maintenance.

zh: 系统太小的话，扣掉固定费用就不划算，所以不推荐
en: Very small systems have fewer panels over which to spread fixed costs, so we do not recommend them.

zh: 板斜着摆时，每排至少要放到正南时的七成，避免出现一排只放一两块的奇怪方案
en: Angled rows must retain at least seven tenths of the due-south panel count, to avoid rows containing only one or two panels.

zh: 机电署对村屋天台系统平均重量的上限。台风压重块没有计算，正式安装要找结构专业人士
en: EMSD sets an average weight limit for village-house rooftop systems. Typhoon ballast is excluded; formal installation needs a structural professional.

zh: 其他费用：低 / 中 / 高
固定费用 2k / 5k / 10k；每年维护 0 / 300 / 1,000；逆变器更换 4k / 5k / 10k（在第 10 年）
设计、电力工程、申请费、清洁维护，以及中途更换一次逆变器的费用
假设（中档为现有默认值）
en: Setup HK$2k / 5k / 10k; annual maintenance HK$0 / 300 / 1,000; inverter HK$4k / 5k / 10k at year 10
Allowances for design, electrical work, applications, cleaning, maintenance and one inverter replacement.

zh: 将来收到的钱不如今天值钱，所以每年打 4% 折扣来比较。证据页显示 0–8% 时的结果
en: Money received later is worth less today, so future cash flows are discounted by 4% a year. The evidence section shows results from 0–8%.

zh: 把 25 年所有收入减去所有支出，全部换算成今天的钱。大于 0 才划算
en: All income minus all costs over 25 years, expressed in today’s money. A positive value indicates a financial surplus under the assumptions.

zh: 累计现金流转正、而且之后不再跌回负数的那个月
en: The month when cumulative cash flow becomes non-negative and never falls below zero again.

zh: 报价高过这个数，25 年下来就是亏本（NPV < 0）
en: Above this quote, the 25-year result has negative net present value.

zh: 上网电价结束后，发的电自己用，可以少付电费
假设（参考中电 2026 年平均净电价）
en: After feed-in payments end, using some electricity yourself can reduce your electricity bill.
Assumption (informed by CLP’s 2026 average net tariff)

zh: 2033 年底後停用系統，之後沒有收入，也沒有維護或更換費用。
上網電價結束後不再運作。自用情景仍計維護費及第 10 年更換逆變器；未計拆除費。
en: Shut down after the end of 2033, with no further income, maintenance or replacement costs.
The system stops operating when FiT ends. The self-use case keeps maintenance and year-10 inverter replacement; removal costs are not modelled.
